correctness.rationale: Exact definition of 20 row-pair-colour load slots yields R=sum choose(k,2); column balances enforce the universal discrete-convexity lower bound. At b=5q with odd q, nonbalanced columns force >=2 extra; balanced cases with zero/one extra would require at most two odd row-pair equality counts, contradicting that all ten row triples each require an odd pair and any pair lies in three triples. Block B has load two in every slot, block C has 16 mutually distinct slots, and W has loads 0,1,2 with counts 2,16,2; the ten-residue construction gives equality in all cases. Standalone verifier tests the exact finite witnesses and independently counts constructed rectangles.

value.rationale: The result is an exact natural five-row infinite-width extremal counting classification directly prompted by Problem 4 in a new paper. It gives a sharp modular failure of the natural lower bound at every odd multiple of five, matching explicit constructions uniformly across all widths. It advances the precise minimum number of forced red/blue four-cycles, beyond binary avoidability or finite lookup values, without requiring a further downstream theorem.
